headline: Approved a $5.00 surcharge on Witch House tickets, to go toward a stabilization fund for municipal and school buildings.
summary: The commission approved use of Salem Willows Field for two races and the Salem Common for a wedding, a parade, and a craft market. It also heard an update on the Winter Island boat ramp and a 1.7 Million Dollars state coastal resiliency grant.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 21, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Approved the increase in Witch House ticket prices to $5.00 to go towards the surcharge, unanimously.
Approved use of Salem Willows Field for the Devils Chase/Creepy Clown Road Race on October 17, 2026, unanimously.
Approved use of Salem Willows Field for the Salem/Marblehead Annual Half Marathon on September 20, 2026, unanimously.
Approved use of Salem Common for the wedding ceremony on June 12, 2027, unanimously.
Approved use of Salem Common for the Haunted Happenings Parade, unanimously.
Approved use of Salem Common for the Biz Baz Craft Market on October 3-4, 2026, unanimously.

MINUTES OF THE SALEM PARK AND RECREATION COMMISSION 
AUGUST 18, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Parks and Recreation Commission was held on August 18, 2026, at 6:45 p.m. at 
401 Bridge Street.  Present were Chair James Shea; Members: Bob Callahan, Amy Everitt and Alex 
Sanchez; Trish O’Brien, Superintendent and Commission Clerk Joanne Roomey . Absent was 
Deborah Amaral. 
 
James Shea, Chairman called the meeting to order at 6:45 p.m. 
1. Approval of Park and Recreation Commission Minutes of July 21, 2026.   
Mr. Callahan made  a motion to approve the Park and Recreation Commission Minutes of  
July 21, 2026.  Ms. Everett seconded the motion. The motion carried unanimously. 
2. Visitors and Requests: 
a. Elizabeth Peterson, Director of Witch House - Request increase in ticket prices for the 
Witch House. 
Trish spoke on behalf of Elizabeth. She stated that, as they do each year, they held several 
meetings to review and analyze admission fees. Following internal research and discussion, 
Elizabeth is proposing a $5 increase in admission fees to the Witch House. 
The proposed admission fees would be: 
• Adults: $17 (currently $12) 
• Seniors: $15 
• Children over the age of 6: $13 
 
Trish noted that the proposed fees would remain lower than other Salem sites. The House of 
Seven Gables and the Phillips House are the closest comparisons, although both facilities are 
considerably larger. Trish said that Elizabeth believes the proposed fees are fair and 
reasonable.
2 
 
Mayor Pangallo appeared and explained why they wanted to request the $5.00 surcharge on 
the Witch House tickets. He said it would be deposited into a special stabilization fund 
account to support municipal and school buildings. 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter.   Ms. Everett made a 
motion to approve the increase in ticket prices to $5.00 to go towards the surcharge.  Mr. 
Callahan seconded the motion.  The motion carried unanimously. 
b. Bill McHugh, Harbor Master, appeared and provided an update regarding the replacement 
of the existing steel piles, at Winter Island boat ramp which provided support for boats 
entering and exiting the water and rise and fall with the tide. The project is considered 
necessary and is intended to improve public fishing and access, with associated costs 
covered through public access funding. 
The project is currently in the engineering phase, with a Notice of Intent anticipated within 
30–45 days. Chapter 91 permitting will follow, with the project expected to go out to bid and 
begin in the spring. The Harbor Master does not anticipate that the area will need to be shut 
down during construction. 
c. Brandi Dion, Halloween Road Race, Salem Willows Field, October 17, 2026. 
Amplification from 8:00am-11:00pm. 
Ashley Steeves appeared on behalf of Brandi Dion for approval to have the Devils 
Chase/Creepy Clown Road Race at Willows Field. It is a 6.66 and a 3.3 mile race and 
nothing has changed since last year. They are going to start the race together like last year. 
No changes. 
Trish stated that her only concern was that both races were being submitted on one 
application. Because it is two races - Moving forward, they need to apply and pay for two 
race fees. 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter.   Mr. Callahan made a 
motion to approve the use of the Salem Willows field.  Ms. Everett seconded the motion.  
The motion carried unanimously. 
d. Ashley Steeves  appeared for approval to have the Salem/Marblehead Annual Half 
Marathon at Salem Willows Field on September 20, 2026. Amplification from 8:00  a.m. 
to 12:00 p.m. She said there are no changes, same as last year. 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter.   Mr. Callahan made a 
motion to approve the use of the Salem Willows Field.  Ms. Everett seconded the motion.  
The motion carried unanimously. 
e. Mike McAuliffe  appeared for approval to have their Wedding Ceremony  at Salem 
Common on June 12, 2027  with amplification from 2:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. He has been 
speaking with Chelsea regarding the details. Trish told him the Gazebo is going under 
construction and thinks it should start in November. She does not think there will be any 
issue but will let them know if things change.
3 
 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter.  Ms. Everett made a 
motion to approve the use of the Salem Common.  Mr. Callahan seconded the motion.  The 
motion carried unanimously. 
f. Jeff Swartz appeared on behalf of Salem Chamber of Commerce, Following events:  
• Haunted Happenings Grande Parade, Parade to end at Salem Common, October 1, 
2026. Amplification from 6:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. The event will be a repeat of last year, 
with the same start and end times. Same DJ.   
He spoke with Chief Miller regarding the placement of the gray barriers. The barriers will 
now be placed farther into the Common, allowing vehicles to travel around the Common. 
The theme is “Old School Halloween.” Digital applications are now available, and all 
information is posted on the Chamber’s website. 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter. Mr. Callahan made a 
motion to approve the use of the Salem Common for the Haunted Happenings Parade.     
Ms. Everett seconded the motion.  The motion carried unanimously. 
• Biz Baz Craft Vendor Market, Salem Common, October 3-4, 2026. Amplification from 
11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. The event will be almost identical to last year, with no changes. A 
DJ will be hired, and the organizers are aware of the decibel limits. There were no issues last 
year. Setup will begin at 7:00 a.m., with staff onsite at 6:30 a.m. to direct parking. 
There being no further questions or comments regarding this matter.   Mr. Sanchez made a 
motion to approve the use of the Salem Common for the Biz Baz Craft Market.  
Mr. Callahan seconded the motion.  The motion carried unanimously. 
3. Old Business: N/A 
4. New Business: Trish said there was an announcement  at Winter Island for a State Coastal 
Resiliency grant for 1.7 Million Dollar s. Salem Sound Coastal Watch  has been a partner in 
studying the issue, and the City has received significant state funding to address it. Neil Duffy, the 
City’s Resiliency Director, will manage the project, with Salem Sound Coastal Watch serving as an 
advisor and partner. The project will focus on restoring and relocating damaged pathways near the 
lighthouse and fort to improve safety. 
5. Adjournment: There being no further business to come before the Salem Park and 
Recreation Commission this evening. Mr. Callahan moved to adjourn the meeting. Seconded 
by Ms. Everett. The meeting was adjourned at 7:20 p.m.   
Respectfully submitted, 
Joanne M. Roomey 
Commission Clerk 
Know your rights under the Open Meeting Law M.G.L. c. 30A §18-25 and
